description: A car manufacturing company makes hamburgers and chicken wraps for workers. They need to ensure workers get at least 2200 calories, 50 grams of protein, and 70 grams of carbs. One hamburger costs $6.5 and contains 800 calories, 19 grams of protein, and 20 grams of carbs. One chicken wrap costs $4 and contains 450 calories, 12 grams of protein, and 10 grams of carbs. What is the minimum cost diet that the company can provide for its workers?

MinNutrient.definition: Minimum required amount for each nutrient

NutrientContent.definition: Amount of each nutrient in each food item

objective.description: "Minimize the total cost of hamburgers and chicken wraps while meeting the required nutritional constraints"
objective.code: model.setObjective(quicksum(Price[i] * FoodQuantity[i] for i in range(NumFoods)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

constraints.description: The total calories provided by hamburgers and chicken wraps must be at least 2200
The total carbohydrates provided by hamburgers and chicken wraps must be at least 70 grams
The number of hamburgers provided must be non-negative
The number of chicken wraps provided must be non-negative

FoodQuantity.definition: Number of units of each food item provided to the workers
